facts.fact_text: According to the applicants, they participated in a number of peaceful demonstrations organised by the opposition.
A demonstration was held on 2 April 2011.
A demonstration was held on 17 April 2011.
A demonstration was held on 20 October 2012.
The second applicant attended the demonstration of 2 April 2011.
The first applicant attended the demonstration of 17 April 2011.
The third applicant attended the demonstration of 17 April 2011.
According to the first applicant, he also intended to participate in the demonstration of 20 October 2012.
According to the applicants, the demonstrations were intended to be peaceful and were conducted in a peaceful manner.
The fourth applicant was one of the organisers of a rally planned by several opposition parties.
The rally organised by several opposition parties was planned to be held on 18 October 2011 in Goychay.
The fourth applicant intended to participate in the rally planned for 18 October 2011 in Goychay.
According to the fourth applicant, the rally planned for 18 October 2011 in Goychay was intended to be peaceful.
The Baku City Executive Authority (the BCEA) refused to authorise the demonstrations at the places indicated by the organisers.
The police began to disperse the demonstration of 2 April 2011 as soon as the protesters began to gather.
The police began to disperse the demonstration of 17 April 2011 as soon as the protesters began to gather.

The circumstances related to the dispersal of the demonstration of 2 April 2011, the second applicant's arrest and custody, and subsequent administrative proceedings against the second applicant are similar to those in Gafgaz Mammadov v. Azerbaijan (no. 60259/11, 15 October 2015).

The circumstances related to the dispersal of the demonstration of 17 April 2011, the first and third applicants' arrests and custody, and subsequent administrative proceedings against the first and third applicants are similar to those in Gafgaz Mammadov v. Azerbaijan (no. 60259/11, 15 October 2015).

The circumstances of the fourth applicant's arrest on 15 October 2011, custody and subsequent administrative proceedings against the fourth applicant are similar to those in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, 11 February 2016).

The circumstances of the first applicant's arrest on 20 October 2012, custody and subsequent administrative proceedings against the first applicant are similar to those in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, 11 February 2016).

A summary of other relevant provisions concerning administrative proceedings, relevant provisions concerning freedom of assembly, the organisation and holding of public assemblies, and relevant extracts from international documents and press releases can be found in the judgment in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, 11 February 2016, §§ 56-77).

A summary of other relevant provisions concerning administrative proceedings, relevant provisions concerning freedom of assembly, the organisation and holding of public assemblies, and relevant extracts from international documents and press releases can also be found in the judgment in Ibrahimov and Others v. Azerbaijan (nos. 69234/11 and 2 others, §§ 44-59, 11 February 2016).

A summary of other relevant provisions concerning administrative proceedings, relevant provisions concerning freedom of assembly, the organisation and holding of public assemblies, and relevant extracts from international documents and press releases can be found in the judgment in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, 11 February 2016, §§ 56-77).

A summary of other relevant provisions concerning administrative proceedings, relevant provisions concerning freedom of assembly, the organisation and holding of public assemblies, and relevant extracts from international documents and press releases can also be found in the judgment in Ibrahimov and Others v. Azerbaijan (nos. 69234/11 and 2 others, §§ 44-59, 11 February 2016).
Prior to the demonstration of 2 April 2011, on 18 March 2011, the organisers gave notice to the Baku City Executive Authority (the BCEA).
Prior to the demonstration of 17 April 2011, on 11 April 2011, the organisers gave notice to the Baku City Executive Authority (the BCEA).
Prior to the demonstration of 20 October 2012, on 15 October 2012, the organisers gave notice to the Baku City Executive Authority (the BCEA).
The Baku City Executive Authority (the BCEA) refused to authorise the demonstrations at the places indicated by the organisers.

The Baku City Executive Authority (the BCEA) proposed a different location on the outskirts of Baku — the grounds of a driving school situated in the 20th residential area of the Sabail District — as an alternative venue for the demonstrations.
The organisers decided to hold the demonstrations as originally planned, notwithstanding the Baku City Executive Authority's refusal to authorise the demonstrations at the places indicated.
According to the fourth applicant, on 9 October 2011, he and the other organisers gave notice of the rally of 18 October 2011 to the Goychay District Executive Authority (the GDEA).
The police began to disperse the demonstration of 2 April 2011 as soon as the protesters began to gather.
The police began to disperse the demonstration of 17 April 2011 as soon as the protesters began to gather.

The circumstances related to the dispersal of the demonstration of 2 April 2011, the second applicant's arrest and custody, and subsequent administrative proceedings against the second applicant are similar to those in Gafgaz Mammadov v. Azerbaijan (no. 60259/11, 15 October 2015).

The circumstances related to the dispersal of the demonstration of 17 April 2011, the first and third applicants' arrests and custody, and subsequent administrative proceedings against the first and third applicants are similar to those in Gafgaz Mammadov v. Azerbaijan (no. 60259/11, 15 October 2015).

The circumstances of the fourth applicant's arrest on 15 October 2011, custody and subsequent administrative proceedings against the fourth applicant are similar to those in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, 11 February 2016).

The circumstances of the first applicant's arrest on 20 October 2012, custody and subsequent administrative proceedings against the first applicant are similar to those in Huseynli and Others v. Azerbaijan (nos. 67360/11 and 2 others, 11 February 2016).
